subject: [PATCH 15/16] selftests/mm: scale khugepaged's collapse wait with the PMD size

2026-08-02.patch_summary: This patch adjusts the wait time in khugepaged's collapse function to scale with the size of the memory being collapsed. The original three-second timeout was insufficient for large PMDs, causing tests to fail even when the collapse completed correctly. The new approach adds a second per 64M of memory to be collapsed, ensuring that the budget is sufficient for all cases. This change brings the helper function in line with khugepaged_full_pass(), which already allows for longer wait times.
